title: Harness source
description: A list of requirements (Yonatan's instructions or ticket specs) and the named checks that prove each one. Check names must exist in harness/checks.mjs.

description.description: What this list is, for a person or an agent reading it cold.

source.description: Where the requirements came from (chat date, Jira keys, Orchestra record).

id.description: I01..I99 for an instruction, or a Jira key for a spec.

words.description: Yonatan's own words, copied as he wrote them. Instructions only.

in.description: What the ticket delivers. Specs only.

checks.description: Names of checks in harness/checks.mjs. All must pass for the requirement to pass.
